import os

from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessorABC
from pocket_coffea.parameters import defaults

localdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

default_parameters = defaults.get_default_parameters()
parameters = defaults.merge_parameters_from_files(
    default_parameters,
    f"{localdir}/params/object_preselection.yaml",
    f"{localdir}/params/triggers.yaml",
    update=True,
)

# --- Binning 1: jet multiplicity (JetGood) ---
njet_binning = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# --- Binning 2: b-tag multiplicity (BJetGood) ---
nbjet_binning = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# --- Cartesian product of the two binnings ---
cartesian_categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_binning, nbjet_binning],
    common_cats=[passthrough],
)

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters=parameters,
    datasets={
        "jsons": [f"{localdir}/datasets/datasets_definitions.json"],
        "filter": {
            "samples": ["TTToSemiLeptonic"],
            "samples_exclude": [],
        },
    },
    workflow=BaseProcessorABC,
    skim=[],
    preselections=[passthrough],
    categories=cartesian_categories,
    weights={
        "common": {
            "inclusive": ["genWeight", "lumi", "XS"],
            "bycategory": {},
        },
    },
    variations={
        "weights": {
            "common": {
                "inclusive": [],
                "bycategory": {},
            },
        },
    },
    variables={},
    columns={},
)
